facts.fact: The StackAdapt article 'How to leverage creatives to learn about your audience' was published on 2020-07-30.
According to StackAdapt, discovery ads are an HTML5 format that tracks user responses to questions or surveys through buttons, a checklist, or a dropdown menu.
facts.quote: The second tactic is to leverage discovery ads, an HTML5 format that allows for the tracking of user responses to questions or surveys.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends A/B testing value propositions or conversion factors rather than elements such as CTA colour or images when gathering consumer insights from creatives.
facts.quote: instead of testing elements such as CTA colour or images, we suggest testing value propositions or conversion factors.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's example, a car rental brand tests price, prestige, or safety messages in a single campaign to see which factor drives the most action.
facts.quote: By running all three of those messages in a single campaign, they will discover which of those factors influences the most action.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's insurance example, a discovery ad run across prospecting and retargeting campaigns shows which insurance products appeal to users depending on their funnel stage.
facts.quote: If they ran the creative across their prospecting and retargeting campaigns, they could see which products appeal to users based on where they are in the funnel.
